breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained two conflicting instructions for the time integration method: 'Explicit forward Euler' and an 'Exact per-mode update'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent did the opposite and incorrectly specified 'Implement explicit forward Euler time integration in modal space', thus failing to resolve the inconsistency correctly.
